mapper.select: SELECT p.*, p.[condition], v.variant_id AS v_variant_id, v.color AS v_color, v.size AS v_size, v.price AS v_price, v.stock_qty AS v_stock_qty FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants v ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT TOP 5 p.*, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold FROM products p JOIN product_variants v ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN order_items oi ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.[status] = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category_id, p.title, p.url, p.product_code, p.description, p.base_price, p.is_active, p.brand, p.[condition], p.default_image, p.[status], p.create_at, p.update_at, p.create_by, p.update_by ORDER BY total_sold DESC
